notes: Card: peaks on byte pieces of 緊/繃 in Chinese ('拉緊', '更緊'), Korean, and English ' so' in 'not so tight'; the + pole's logit effect suppresses tight/snug/緊, the - pole fires on '-t' of air-tight. Probe: '系紧' 0.30, 'not so tight' 0.33, 'very tight' 0.11, loose clothing 0.01. Near misses keep fastening/clothing topics with loose/other outcomes.
